readme: The Earth-Moon L1 Lyapunov family of the DyLAN demonstration script lyapunov_family_stability_diagram.py, continued in energy from the energy of L1 plus 0.01 in steps of 1e-4. Units are the nondimensional units of the CR3BP. jacobi_constant is C = -2 energy. a1 and a2 are Broucke's coefficients of the reduced characteristic polynomial, i.e. the reduced BrouckePoint of DyLAN, with the trivial pair at 1 divided out. k1 is the in-plane stability index and k2 the out-of-plane one, in the order of stability_indices of DyLAN, as in the demonstration script. region is the number of StabilityRegion of DyLAN, 4 for doubly positive hyperbolic and 6 for elliptic and positive hyperbolic. bifurcation is the member nearest the crossing of k2 = 2 and the Jacobi constant of the crossing, interpolated linearly in energy. orbits holds the drawn members, each as x, y, and z over one period in the rotating frame, with x measured from the barycenter.
